_comment: CloudWatch agent config for the k3s node. Ships the container logs of every pod in the lighting namespace (k3s writes them as /var/log/pods/<namespace>_<pod>_<uid>/<container>/<n>.log; the real files are read rather than the /var/log/containers symlinks) to the same log group as the host VM. ${LOG_GROUP} is filled in by k3s-bootstrap.sh.
